title: Slopworks: Grok Bot updates and known issues
description: Unofficial, fan-built project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Grok Bot, SpaceX, or X.

items.title: Issue (open): Chats and drafts don't always sync to the Grok app
items.content_text: Two users on X reported that, using Grok Bots inside the Grok app, chats don't always sync: drafts the bot says are in the chat show up on one device or app but not the other. Second report: https://x.com/i/status/2111295921539699143

items.title: Robinhood, Coinbase, Trello, and more connectors
items.content_text: Grok Bot now connects to Robinhood, Coinbase, Trello, PostHog, beehiiv, eToro, and more. Teams can also now submit connectors to the Grok Bot marketplace.

items.title: Grok Bot can read X Chat
items.content_text: Grok Bot can now read X Chat. Connect X, then ask it to work across your messages.

items.title: Notifications only on the device you're using
items.content_text: Grok Bot notifications now go only to the device you're using.

items.title: Tag @bot on X to start a task
items.content_text: Tag @bot in a post on X and Grok Bot gets to work on it.

items.title: Faster, more reliable voice calls
items.content_text: Voice calls with Grok Bot are faster, more reliable, and better at remembering past conversations.

items.title: Grok Bot is much faster
items.content_text: The Grok Bot team says computer tasks now finish 3x sooner on average, and replies to everything else arrive in less than half the time.

items.title: Refreshed look with a new typeface and themes
items.content_text: Grok Bot has a refreshed look, with a new typeface and themes.

items.title: Redesigned chat cards
items.content_text: Cards in Grok Bot chats have a new design with a cleaner layout, part of an update the team says improves quality, polish, and speed.

items.title: Issue (open): Plugins page lists fewer Finance accounts than are connected
items.content_text: A user on X reported that Grok Bot's Your plugins page shows only one of two connected Plaid finance institutions, while Grok's Connectors shows both. They said Grok Bot itself still works; only the page is wrong.

items.title: Issue (open): Convex plugin stuck on an old version
items.content_text: A user replying to the plugin submission post said the Convex plugin is still pinned to version 1.0.0, which ships always-on rules that take about 30k tokens of context, even though the plugin's own project fixed that. A team member acknowledged the report.

items.title: Plugins can be submitted
items.content_text: A Grok Bot team member shared that anyone can submit plugins for Grok Bot (and Grok and Cursor) through a public submission form.

items.title: Issue (open): Locked out during plan unification
items.content_text: A user on X reported being locked out of Grok Bot for about two days while moving to the unified plan. A team member replied that they are looking into it.

items.title: Plus aliases for Grok Bot email
items.content_text: Grok Bot email supports plus aliases: send and receive with dedicated aliases, or set routines that trigger only for mail sent to one alias.

items.title: Basecamp connector launched
items.content_text: Basecamp announced an official Grok Bot connector, available from Connect Apps inside Grok Bot.

items.title: Issue (fixed): 404 errors on unified plan link
items.content_text: Users replying to the unified plan announcement got 404 errors from a shared link. A team member said the cause was mitigated.

items.title: Grok Bot X Communities
items.content_text: The team opened applications for curated Grok Bot group chats on X for GTM, product, marketing, engineering, recruiting, and design.

items.title: Weekly roundup video
items.content_text: A team video walks through the week: Bot's own email, better X, Shopify, more color, email drafts, Bot's computer, template search, PR previews, routine right-clicks, and 5 new languages.

items.title: One plan for Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, and X
items.content_text: The X Subscription is one plan covering Cursor, Grok, Grok Bot, and X Premium. Every change is opt-in; if you do nothing, nothing changes.

items.title: Grok Bot gets its own email
items.content_text: Bots can use their own email address to sign up for services, contact businesses for you, or schedule time with someone.

items.title: Shopify connector
items.content_text: Connect Shopify, then ask Grok Bot to check orders, track inventory, and keep product listings up to date.

items.title: Search, read, and monitor X
items.content_text: Grok Bot can now search, read, and monitor X.

items.title: Usage limits reset
items.content_text: Usage limits were reset for all Grok Bot users.

items.title: Proactive suggestions
items.content_text: Grok Bot can now suggest ways to help without you needing to ask.

items.title: Better for building software
items.content_text: Bots can hand off coding tasks to Cursor, manage PRs with the GitHub and Origin plugins, and share video demos of what they build.

items.title: Finance integration
items.content_text: Link bank, card, and investment accounts with the new Finance integration, then ask Grok Bot to help manage spending and investments.

items.title: Cleaner interface
items.content_text: Quality-of-life update with a cleaner interface for working with your bots.

items.title: Voice notes
items.content_text: Grok Bot can now send you voice notes.

items.title: Grok Bot can talk
items.content_text: Grok Bot can now talk.

items.title: 1Password
items.content_text: Grok Bot can use 1Password: share items in a vault, approve each fill, and the secrets stay in your password manager.
